I would like my diplomats protected when I send them to foreign nations thankyou
Changed the channel name: [Next] GA - Repeal "Diplomat Protection Act"
Changed the channel name: [At Vote] GA - Repeal "Diplomat Protection Act"

I wrote a repeal of this [years ago](https://forum.nationstates.net/viewtopic.php?f=9&t=523911), which Simone later modified into [his own draft](https://forum.nationstates.net/viewtopic.php?f=9&t=538836) with my permission. This effort by Vara and co is completely independent of that. While I think the choice to focus on "diplomatic impunity" rather than more genuinely bizarre/dangerous stuff like "you have to prioritize random foreign aides over your own national leaders in emergencies and also can't do investigations" weakens this repeal, it's also targeting a genuine piece of crap that has a lot wrong with it to choose from, and there's merit to having a distinct angle to your own later draft on the same topic even if that angle isn't as strong (regardless of whether the different angle was intentional or coincidental). Maybe I'm just glad to see the target finally gone, but I'm personally in favor of this
Repeal "Diplomat Protection Act" was passed 7,500 votes to 3,323 (69.3% support). TEP voted against 3-8-1-1.
